title: On Donkin's Tilting Module Conjecture IV: New Frontiers
summary: Let $G$ be a simple, simply connected algebraic group scheme defined over $\mathbb{F}_{p}$, and let $G_{r}$ be the $r$th Frobenius kernel. Donkin's famous Tilting Module Conjecture purports that a given indecomposable injective $G_{r}$-module can be realized as the restriction of a specific tilting module. The conjecture was first stated in 1990 and withstood proof for nearly 30 years. The authors discovered a counterexample in 2019. This paper provides some indication about the rich mathematics surrounding the Tilting Module Conjecture that also discusses an older conjecture by Humphreys…
